name: Snow White Ashes
source:
One winter night, you meet a hunter in the woods: A man so warm and gentle you feel as if you've known him all your life.

But appearances can be deceiving. 

You'd know that well, wouldn't you?

[From [url=https://endysis.itch.io/snow-white]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个冬天的夜晚，你在树林里遇到了一位猎人：一个温暖而温柔的男人，让你感觉好像你已经认识他一辈子了。

但外表可能具有欺骗性。

你很清楚这一点，不是吗？

[来自[url=https://endysis.itch.io/snow-white]itch.io[/url]]
